cover.title: 5 niche things that will make you dangerously good at the eu ai act

inner.title: say you're an ai
inner.body: since 2 august 2026, a chatbot must tell people they're talking to ai. the commission says the 'it's obvious' exception is read narrowly.

inner.title: mark what you generate
inner.body: ai images, audio, video and text need machine-readable marks. if your tool shipped before august, your grace period ends 2 december 2026.

inner.title: know your fine
inner.body: breaking the transparency rules can cost up to €15m or 3% of turnover. startups pay whichever is lower, which is still not zero.

inner.title: check if you're high-risk
inner.body: the digital omnibus moved annex iii high-risk rules to 2 december 2027. a delay is a deadline, not an exemption.

inner.title: jump the sandbox queue
inner.body: startups with an eu office get priority access to ai regulatory sandboxes. every member state should have one running by august 2027.

closer.HEADLINE:
the ai act isn't coming.
it already applies.
closer.SUBLINE: and the next deadline is 2 december.
closer.TONIGHT: make your chatbot say it's an ai
